entities.name: Gonzalo II Fernández de Córdoba
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gonzalo II Fernández de Córdoba, 3rd Duke of Sessa, 1st Duke of Baena was a Spanish aristocrat who held several dukedoms and many other lesser titles, Spanish and Italian; he was Captain General of the Spanish Troops in Italy, Great Admiral of the Kingdom of Naples, and a member of the Spanish King Royal Council for Italy and the Royal War Council.
